name: Poshan Calculator
tagline: Smart Child Growth Assessment using WHO Standards

hero.title: Monitor Child Growth with Confidence
hero.subtitle: Poshan Calculator helps parents, pediatricians, healthcare professionals and Anganwadi workers assess child growth using WHO Growth Standards. Calculate BMI, Age, Height-for-Age, Weight-for-Age, Weight-for-Height and nutritional status within seconds.

overview: Poshan Calculator is a healthcare application that simplifies child growth assessment using WHO Child Growth Standards. It eliminates manual calculations and enables parents and healthcare professionals to quickly evaluate a child's nutritional status through an intuitive mobile experience.

modules.title: BMI Calculator
modules.description: Calculate Body Mass Index using WHO recommendations.

modules.title: Age Calculator
modules.description: Calculate exact age in years, months and days.

modules.title: Weight-for-Age
modules.description: Assess whether a child's weight is appropriate for their age.

modules.title: Height-for-Age
modules.description: Evaluate growth using WHO height standards.

modules.title: Weight-for-Height
modules.description: Identify acute malnutrition using WHO charts.

modules.title: Nutrition Assessment
modules.description: Quickly determine the child's nutritional status.

why_choose: Designed for healthcare professionals and parents

faq.question: What can I calculate using Poshan Calculator?
faq.answer: You can calculate BMI, Age, Weight-for-Age, Height-for-Age, Weight-for-Height and assess child nutritional status using WHO Growth Standards.

faq.question: Does the application work offline?
faq.answer: Yes. All growth calculations work completely offline.

faq.question: Who is this application designed for?
faq.answer: Parents, pediatricians, healthcare professionals, Anganwadi workers and nutrition experts.

faq.question: Which growth standard is used?
faq.answer: The application follows the WHO Child Growth Standards for accurate child growth assessment.

data_safety.shared_data: No data shared with third parties.
data_safety.security: All growth calculations are performed locally on the device.
